title: docs(rangeSlider): update story
body:
This updates the [`rangeSlider`](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/range-slider/js/) stories to make them more representative of what the widget offers:

* remove non-existant `templates.header` option
* remove custom `tooltips` option by default
* update the `step` value to be more usable and remove `pips` for the story so that it's less confusing (the step is not aligned with the pip)
